paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
notes: Paper proposes resonant-mass detectors to probe scalar DM (moduli) coupling to electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic field (d_e). The exclusion/projection plot (Fig.1) covers both d_me and d_e couplings over mass range ~1e-22 to 1e-4 eV (frequencies 1 kHz - 1 GHz). Primarily projections (Cu-Si sphere, DUAL, quartz) plus a recast AURIGA limit and Earth seismology limit. Coupling type ScalarElectron (d_me) is one of two couplings shown; could also be ScalarPhoton (d_e). The only explicit numerical limit values given in text are EP/5F bounds and the Earth seismology limit |de+dme| < 2.5e-4 at f~8.1e-4 Hz; no tabulated curve data available. Numerical (mass, coupling) pairs for the projected detector curves are not provided in the text, only described qualitatively. | Vision: Figure 1 shows multiple coupling constraints (d_e and d_me) on the same vertical axis log10|d_i|. The plotted boundary traced is the lower envelope of d_e constraints: Dy d_e (purple) at low masses and EP d_e (orange dashed, ~2.98e-4) at intermediate masses. The natural d_e green band rises at high mass. Coupling type is ScalarPhoton (d_e, electromagnetic gauge modulus / fine-structure constant variation). Note the paper also discusses d_me (ScalarElectron); both appear in the same plot, hence reduced confidence on coupling assignment. | CV axis calibration succeeded (ranges consistent with LLM) | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=1.00 snapped to identity)
